I’d like her to be wearing a Chinese-style outfit, and I’d like to leave the composition and expression up to you.

Hello! I really love your beautiful dynamic illustrations and amazing backgrounds! I'd like to request art for my future Vtuber debut! 

My character is a previously spoiled mermaid, who was raised in a laboratory. She is originally naive and a little mischievous. Her life falls apart when they find her lacking of any abilities they hoped to take advantage of. They experiment on her, eventually discarding her. She transforms on the brink of death and seeks revenge. 

I'd love for you to draw her main white outfit, and possibly reference  the red/black outfit of her transformation as a shadow, easter egg, or hint in the background! Please have the illustration be in landscape/horizontal canvas, as I'd like to use it as a wallpaper on my stream or share to members of my community! You'll be credited anywhere it is used. I leave the composition of the piece up to you. Thank you for considering my request, I hope you have a wonderful day.

Nice to meet you. My name is Mikazuki Dokuro.
I’m reaching out to request an illustration for a “Cover Song MV” of “Today Is Goodbye.”

[Intended Use]

* Posting the cover song MV on YouTube
* Promotional and announcement posts for the MV on X (formerly Twitter)


[Character Reference]
■ Main Character (Mikazuki Dokuro)
https://drive.google.com/file/d/144los9bhbsnZK7fyqykDoSxxHhrZzzGm/view?usp=drivesdk

■ Partner Character
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1yLWhaM_vVNY8hBBmrFmWho3r0U7BJC80/view?usp=drivesdk

This illustration is intended for use in the “Today Is Goodbye” cover music video.

Actually, since my partner has decided to stop performing, I’d like to create this music video as a gift to her.
I’d be happy if you could create a warm yet slightly bittersweet atmosphere that conveys a sense of gratitude—“Thank you for everything so far”—rather than one that simply mourns our parting.

As for the composition:

・The main character should be the one with white and blue hair (Mikazuki Dokuro)
・She should appear to be on good terms with the girl in pink
・The composition should make it clear that the white-and-blue-haired character is the protagonist
・It’s okay if the girl in pink isn’t actually in the frame, as long as there’s a depiction of the white-and-blue-haired character thinking of her

Thank you in advance.

https://drive.google.com/file/d/144los9bhbsnZK7fyqykDoSxxHhrZzzGm/view?usp=drivesdk

Dear Shaane-sama,
Nice to meet you.
I’m a VTuber active on YouTube.
My name is Emu Sakado.

I had the pleasure of seeing
your illustrations with that dark atmosphere,
and I was truly drawn to how wonderful they are.
I’m a bit nervous to ask,
but I’d really like to commission you,
so this is my first time reaching out.



◇Commission Details◇
An illustration of Emu Sakado herself
for Halloween in October.
I absolutely love the gothic-style
atmosphere in your artwork, Syaaaaneeeyona-sama,
so I would be delighted if you could design her outfit
to match that style.

I apologize for the trouble,
but I would greatly appreciate your consideration.

I’m attaching some of my favorite reference images.
https://skeb.jp/@syaaaaneeeyona/works/53
https://skeb.jp/@syaaaaneeeyona/works/43
https://skeb.jp/@syaaaaneeeyona/works/22


About Emu Sado
She has an extremely strong love for her listeners
and is a mentally unstable, yandere character who is quite jealous and greedy.
She often says she wants to trap her listeners in a bottle.
She has a strong tendency to kill anyone who cheats on her.
Blood and gore are fine, so please feel free to draw her however you like.

◇Intended Use◇
Use in YouTube livestreams [Monetized]
Use in promotional posts on social media
Digital distribution via Fanbox, etc.
◇Notes◇
Since this may be used for thumbnails and similar purposes,
please ensure that no parts of the illustration—such as the top of the head, hair, or hands near the face—
are cut off.

Preferred Delivery Format
・PSD format
It would be very helpful for my activities
if you could separate the background, character, and signature into individual layers.

I’ve attached reference materials at the bottom of this post.
Please use them as a guide.
Character Data
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1J5PjQzaC4DKRbCibmpDV8lLMvmPPDVz0?usp=sharing

Nice to meet you. My name is Meito Meidoin.
I was so impressed by your illustrations, Shaane-sama, that I decided to send you a request to commission a single-panel illustration.

I would like to request a single-panel illustration of my original character, "Meito Meidoin."
She streams as a yandere maid.
 I prefer an atmosphere that feels mysterious and hints at a sense of fear or madness, rather than a bright and cute impression.
I have attached character design reference materials.

I’ll leave the composition, expression, and whether or not to include a background up to you.
I welcome your interpretation and creative arrangements.

She holds a skeleton as a prop, but you don’t need to include it in the illustration.
Please do not include highlights in her eyes.

I also plan to use the illustration for my streaming activities.
I intend to use it for digital merchandise, promotional activities on social media, as a thumbnail for my monetized streaming account, and as a single-image panel during in-stream events.
Therefore, I would appreciate it if you could provide a transparent image of just the character.

I would greatly appreciate it if you could consider this request.
Thank you in advance.
